kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نقتلع (form VIII)
# نَقْتَلِعُ (naqtaliʕu) /naq.ta.li.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
# نُقْتَلَعُ (nuqtalaʕu) /nuq.ta.la.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
# نَقْتَلِعَ (naqtaliʕa) /naq.ta.li.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
# نُقْتَلَعَ (nuqtalaʕa) /nuq.ta.la.ʕa/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
